name: Turn A Blind Optic
source:
The war is over. Optimus is dead. The Decepticons have renounced their cause.
And, to make matters worse, Starscream is in the medbay again.
In which Bumblebee mistakes a consensual BDSM-relationship for abuse, and tries to save a rather bewildered Seeker.

[From [url=https://useless19.itch.io/turn-a-blind-optic]Itch.io[/url]]

A short story based on [url=https://archiveofourown.org/works/16941060]Turn A Blind Optic[/url], a Transformers fan-fiction written by [url=https://archiveofourown.org/users/Transformatron/pseuds/Transformatron]Transformatron[/url].
translation:
战争结束了。擎天柱死了。霸天虎已经放弃了他们的事业。
而且，更糟糕的是，红蜘蛛又出现在医疗湾了。
其中大黄蜂将双方同意的BDSM关系误认为是虐待，并试图拯救一位相当困惑的探索者。

[来自[url=https://useless19.itch.io/turn-a-blind-optic]Itch.io[/url]]

基于 [url=https://archiveofourown.org/works/16941060]Turn A Blind Optic[/url] 的短篇故事，这是由 [url=https://archiveofourown.org/users/Transformatron/pseuds/Transformatron]Transformatron[/url] 撰写的变形金刚同人小说。
